case.summary: Case HHG-016 was opened for customer C09988 after a dispute on online transaction 3534820 for $59.67 on card C09988-K1. Graph analysis identified a card_not_present_new_device pattern with a fraud probability of 0.90 due to an online episode utilizing a device marked New for this account. Consequently, final actions include recommending BLOCK_CARD on route L1 and CREATE_CASE on route auto.
